title: scenarios: travel_expense's committed verified build now fails master-detail-inline-edit ("0 edited inline") under today's scorer
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (a committed fixture no longer passes the gate it was verified against) · Source: fleet (out-of-scope finding of the #34920 card thread, PR #37911; seat read of the scorer history on `main`)

## What happens

`docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json`, the verified build the ask-day round installs with `--template`, scored Build 135/135 on 2026-11-18. Re-scored by today's scorer it fails one check, `records-forms.master-detail-inline-edit`: "0 edited inline" (the #34920 thread, re-scoring it while refreshing `travel_expense.provenance.json`'s `cardSha256`).

The card did not cause it: with and without the card change of #37781 the build reads 140/141 under the same scorer. The scorer did: PR #37135 (2026-11-24) credits master-detail inline edit by the master's field groups instead of `inlineEdit: true` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts`, about :495-515).

The ask-day round does not score Build, so day-round readings are unaffected. A round that builds from this fixture, or a reader of its provenance, sees a "verified" build that the current gate refuses.

## Expected

- [ ] Decide which side is right on this build: the build's master/detail layout should earn the check (then the scorer is narrower than the card), or it should not (then the fixture is re-verified, or rebuilt, and its provenance says which scorer it passed).
- [ ] The fixture's provenance names the scorer revision it was verified against, so the next scorer change is visible as a re-score, not a silent failure.

Grade: area:eval · bug · reach: one committed fixture and its provenance · evidence: the thread's re-score above, `git log` of `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score` on `main`
Suggested-grade: p3
Size: S
Related: #34920, PR #37911, PR #37135, #37781.
